resolvedPrompt: A pixel art sprite sheet: the same character drawn 4 times in a single horizontal row, evenly spaced on a plain white background, identical size and colors in every frame, feet on one shared baseline. Every frame is drawn from the SAME camera angle — true side view, facing right, camera at eye level — the character never turns or rotates between frames, only its pose changes. The four poses, left to right: (1) right foot planted far forward, left leg trailing behind, body leaning into the step, (2) passing pose: left knee lifted high in front, standing tall on the right foot, (3) left foot planted far forward, right leg trailing behind, body leaning into the step, (4) passing pose: right knee lifted high in front, standing tall on the left foot. Large, clearly different poses — no text, no labels, no numbers in the image.
